facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Many people came. They bought the shoes. He made a lot of money. He became rich.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The shoemaker's shop became famous in the whole town. People lined up every day to buy his beautiful shoes. He earned more money than he ever imagined. He became rich and could buy anything he needed. But he never forgot the little elves who helped him. He was thankful every single day for their kindness.
facts.Word cards: became = 됐다 / rich = 부자인 / sold = 팔렸다 / earned = 벌었다
